cues.text: A wide round platform, traced with glowing lines and ringed by tall pillars.
Each pillar bears a bird statue. Far off, the team walks in.
They look around. Ken gazes upward.
Black feathers peel off the bird statues and swirl upward.
The team spreads out, Koromaru among them.
Streams of black feathers rise from every statue, higher and higher.
They converge on a huge full moon and knot together at its centre.
In front of the moon, the feathers churn into a dark, tangled mass.
Something bursts out of it: great black wings veined with glowing blue.
A slender figure, wings spread wide, grips a long golden blade.
It hovers high above the team, who stand small among the pillars.
Its face: a pale mask with hollow eyes and a wide, fixed smile.
